A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa']]'''[[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]]''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as a '''[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]''' under the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 44" /> the Jedi was sent with fellow Jedi [[Finn Ertay/Legends|Finn Ertay]] to [[Duel at unidentified Outer Rim spaceport/Legends|confront]] the deadly [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] brothers, [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] at an [[Unidentified Outer Rim spaceport/Legends|Outer Rim spaceport]]. In the [[Lightsaber duel|duel]], the Nikto was kicked in the chest by Maul and dropped to his knees. Ertay slid beneath Maul in an attempt to save her fellow Jedi, but in the process left her back exposed for a [[Death/Legends|killing]] blow by Maul. Shortly afterwards, the Nikto Jedi was also killed.<ref name="Revival" />

==Equipment==
The Jedi wielded a [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. He also wore [[Jedi armor|armor]] over both his arms,<ref name="Revival" /> as many other Jedi did during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Season 1">[[The Clone Wars: Season One|''The Clone Wars'': Season One]]</ref><ref name="The Clone Wars: Season 2">[[The Clone Wars: Season Two|''The Clone Wars'': Season Two]]</ref><ref name="The Clone Wars: Season 3">[[The Clone Wars: Season Three|''The Clone Wars'': Season Three]]</ref><ref name="The Clone Wars: Season 4">[[The Clone Wars: Season Four|''The Clone Wars'': Season Four]]</ref><ref name="The Clone Wars: Season 5">[[The Clone Wars: Season Five|''The Clone Wars'': Season Five]]</ref><ref name="The Clone Wars: Season 6">''[[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions]]''</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
This Nikto was sensitive to the force, therefore being trained as a Jedi. He was skilled in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] and was able to hold off [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] for a brief time. He was also an aggressive adversary, demonstrating this when he launched a very aggressive blow at Opress during the duel. Despite his skill, he lacked finesse, being out of balance in his attack pattern. This weakness allowed Opress to gain the upper hand, resulting in the death of the Jedi.<ref name="Revival" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unnamed Jedi first appeared in the opening newsreel of "[[Revival (episode)|Revival]]," the first episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which first aired on [[September 29]], [[2012]].<ref name="SWTCWEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>

The character's pre-visualization model was used in an alternate battle sequence for the episode "[[Nightsisters (episode)|Nightsisters]]" where he would aid in the battle and pursue [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. In this deleted scene he is known as "Master Ma'kis", and helps to corner Asajj in a hangar-bay onboard a capital-ship with [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Ma'kis became separated from the other three Jedi and had to fight Ventress by himself. The cargo in the hangar-bay would hinder the battle, distracting Ma'kis, allowing Ventress to stab him to death.<ref name="The Complete Season Three">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]]</ref>

The model of the Jedi was based off of [[Jedi Master]] [[Ima-Gun Di]]'s model,<ref name="Revival EG">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/revival-episode-guide|text="Revival" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> who appeared in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|Season Three]] episode "[[Supply Lines]]," set in 22 BBY,<ref name="22BBY">{{TCWcanondates|303}}</ref> in which he died.<ref name="Supply Lines">{{TCW|Supply Lines}}</ref>
